key_facts.fact: Nine-match winning streak and 100% winrate last month provides strong momentum entering this BO3
Very strong Dust2 record: 75% winrate across 24 maps, chosen early (92% first-pick).
Exceptional Cache form: 89% winrate over nine maps, reliable pick against opponents.
Poor Anubis results: only 33% winrate across 15 maps, risky decider map.
Strong momentum: five-match winning streak and 86% winrate last month boosts confidence.
Reliable Dust2 performance: 75% winrate across 12 maps; valuable pick in veto scenarios.
Terrible head-to-head versus Vitality: 13% winrate historically, psychological disadvantage likely.
Weak Cache form: 33% winrate across only three maps; vulnerable if Vitality picks Cache.
